characterDescription: A precise, monospaced editorial navigation system built on IBM Plex Mono — clinical and typographically rigid, suggesting a luxury brand that deliberately subverts conventional fashion typography with a coder's sensibility. The 0.08em letter spacing on nav links enforces wide-set uppercase tracking that feels printed rather than rendered. The auto-hide-on-scroll with hover-reveal mechanism and expo-eased slide transitions signal restraint and considered interaction choreography over decorative excess.
